description: The official historical baseline and an equivalent archival corpus are absent; rendered open-web searches are not exhaustive and do not reproduce LexisNexis/all-news coverage.
required_followup: Coordinator review of the official baseline/archive scope; retain bounded open-web status.

description: Queries Q008–Q013 extended search through March 31 and checked later-month worker/transport/region leads in Romanian, English and Russian, but results often recycled March 12–16 stories or surfaced out-of-month material. No systematic primary local coverage inventory exists for each raion, Transnistria, Gagauzia, or separate labor/education/health sectors.
required_followup: Further allowed local/regional and sector sources may resolve attendance, source independence and event occurrence; do not claim complete monthly or geographic coverage.

description: The March 21 transporter gathering is confirmed, but Radio Moldova reports only approximately 40–50 and Moldova 1 says ‘dozens’; the simultaneous 50-person threshold is unresolved. The two Teleradio-Moldova outlets share a publisher organization.
required_followup: Seek an independent contemporary attendance estimate if feasible; keep participant bounds null and status pending_threshold unless 50+ simultaneous attendance is established.

description: March 26 unionist gathering is described as ‘dozens’ by NewsMaker relaying TV8; its direct target toward the Moldovan state is not established. A separate counter-protest invoked neutrality and independence but has no attendance estimate or formal demand to authorities.
required_followup: Preserve the two gatherings separately; identify any direct state-directed demand and independent group-specific headcount before considering inclusion.

description: The March 12, 13 and 15 Șor/Movement actions have no reliable site-level simultaneous attendance estimates in the opened material. Detentions, paid transport or road-block reports are not participant counts.
required_followup: Keep candidates pending threshold unless a saved contemporaneous account supplies a valid site/time attendance figure.

description: For several dated gatherings, reports do not establish physical end times or full endings; police warnings, identification/detention claims and crowd dispersal need to stay event-specific and distinguishable.
required_followup: Retain unknown end/response fields unless existing source text explicitly establishes a physical ending or response.
